claude_proposed_widenings.name: alter_creature_kind
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: True Polymorph's core mechanic is replacing a creature's stat block with a different creature type, or converting a creature into a nonmagical object (and vice versa). None of the existing Effect atoms (damage, heal, modify_ac, etc.) can represent this. The v4 atom alter_item_kind covers item transformations only. A new atom for creature/object polymorphism is required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature shape-shifts into a different creature or a nonmagical object... The target's game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the new form

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_temp_hp
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Creature-into-Creature mode grants THP equal to the new form's HP maximum. The current Effect union has no temporary-HP grant atom, and the v4 taxonomy does not list grant_temp_hp as a distinct atom (modify_max_hp is a different operation).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the new form. These Temporary Hit Points vanish if any remain when the spell ends.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Duration.concentration_escalates_to_permanent
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: True Polymorph's duration is 'concentration up to 1 hour, but if you maintain Concentration for the full duration the spell lasts until dispelled.' The existing Duration type has no variant that models concentration that escalates to a permanent timed effect after surviving its full window. A new variant (e.g., { kind: 'concentration_then_permanent'; upTo: DurationValue }) is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: if you maintain Concentration on this spell for the full duration, the spell lasts until dispelled

claude_proposed_widenings.name: create_companion (surface gap)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Object-into-Creature mode produces a Friendly creature that obeys commands — semantically create_companion. This atom exists in the v4 taxonomy but is absent from types.ts. Separate from the atom_widening items above; this is a surface-only gap.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature is Friendly to you and your allies. In combat, it takes its turns immediately after yours, and it obeys your commands.
